RUS.scope: Russia revenue under the player's custom tax system (13% flat PIT, 20% CIT, 56% oil/gas net-profit tax, 20%/8% VAT, excises, regressive payroll tax), calibrated to the 1996 budget law revenue of 347.2tn rubles (about $69.4B at 5,000/US$). Split between taxes estimated.

mechs.name: Employer payroll tax (regressive, 35.6% to 2%)
mechs.note: Player system: employer payroll tax, 35.6% at low incomes falling to 2% for top earners; modelled as 35.6% with a wage-base cap so the average rate falls with income.

mechs.name: Oil and gas net-profit tax (56%)
mechs.note: Player system: 56% net-profit tax on oil and natural gas companies.

mechs.name: Value-added tax (20%, 8% reduced)
mechs.note: Player system: 20% VAT, 8% on medicine, food, books, public transport and baby goods (modelled as an exempt/reduced share of the base).

mechs.name: Excise: alcohol and tobacco (80%)
mechs.note: Player system: 80% excise on alcohol and tobacco.

mechs.name: Excise: jewelry and luxury goods (24%)
mechs.note: Player system: 24% excise on jewelry, furs, high-end carpets, porcelain and crystal.

mechs.name: Excise: cars over 2.0 L (14%)
mechs.note: Player system: 14% excise on cars with engines over 2.0 L.

mechs.name: Excise: cars under 2.0 L (3%)
mechs.note: Player system: 3% excise on cars with engines under 2.0 L.

mechs.name: Foreign trade duties
mechs.note: Export duties on oil and gas plus import duties.

mechs.name: Non-tax and other revenue
mechs.note: Non-tax revenues, CBR profit transfers, privatization and other receipts.
